🔥 free-coding-models | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable developers to quickly discover, evaluate, and deploy the most performant and stable free coding LLMs for their development workflow.
✨ Key Features: • Find and benchmark 170+ free coding LLM models • Support for 15+ providers • Real-time latency and stability scores • Live uptime and jitter metrics
📖 Summary: free-coding-models is a command-line interface tool that helps developers find, benchmark, and install free coding Large Language Models (LLMs) from various providers. It provides real-time latency, stability scores, and usage data to help users select the best model for their needs and integrate it directly into their coding tools.
